newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds narrowly mixed, confidence gaining.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds narrowly mixed, confidence gaining.

text.p: Argentine bonds were narrowly mixed late morning Friday as traders reported a further bolstering of confidence after the release of the U.S. jobs report.
"The market is sustained - there was foreign demand in the morning," said a trader at a foreign bank.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 was up 1/8 at 92-3/8, while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 2 was $0.03 lower at 126.15.
The market's confidence has risen all week as fears of hikes in U.S. interest rates have declined on the back of soft U.S. indicators.
That has meant traders are more prepared to conclude that the market has come out of its thin, dull range-trading of recent weeks.
"The market is another thing altogether now," said another trader.
